data.narrative: Student demonstrated advanced systems engineering and distributed systems reliability by implementing an asynchronous Redis Cache-Aside pattern on the hot redirect path, enforcing end-to-end tenant isolation in cached payloads, and validating graceful fallback during Redis outages. The student systematically debugged and resolved the silent cache-invalidation defect on link updates, proving zero stale reads across regression test suites.

dimension_scores.observation: Clearly articulated why Cache-Aside is superior for read-dominated redirect paths over Write-Through, explicitly balancing operational decoupling against the responsibility of manual cache invalidation.
dimension_scores.evidence: Choosing the Cache-Aside strategy had the biggest impact. It allowed us to control cache population, TTL, and invalidation while keeping PostgreSQL as the source of truth, avoiding write-path dependencies on Redis.

dimension_scores.observation: Constructed an automated 8-step reproduction script that proved PostgreSQL was updated while Redis served stale redirects, repaired the missing invalidation call in update_link post-commit, and confirmed eviction and fresh repopulation.
dimension_scores.evidence: Targeted FIX reproduction passed all 8 checks, demonstrating cache eviction upon PATCH commit, followed by public redirects returning the updated destination rather than stale data.

dimension_scores.observation: Embedded organization scoping into cached link payloads and enforced strict cross-tenant isolation, preventing unauthorized organizations from evicting or reading other tenants' cache keys.
dimension_scores.evidence: Cache payloads store org_id and invalidate_redirect_target verifies ownership; cross-tenant mutation attempts are rejected without cache leakage.

dimension_scores.observation: Engineered non-blocking fallback logic with 1.0s socket timeouts to ensure Redis outages never cause 500 errors or hung requests, dynamically bounded cache TTL to link expiration, and identified thundering herd mitigations.
dimension_scores.evidence: Redirect succeeded via PostgreSQL fallback while Redis was unavailable; identified single-flight coalescing and probabilistic early expiration for cache stampede defense.

dimension_scores.observation: Provided crisp, structured explanations of core caching mechanics, failure modes, and concrete evidence without unnecessary jargon.
dimension_scores.evidence: Comprehension answers concisely explained performance gains, the dual-write invalidation responsibility, and the exact verification metrics.

strengths: Disciplined understanding of distributed state management and cache consistency trade-offs
Strong implementation of graceful degradation patterns under infrastructure outages
Rigorous automated testing methodology proving both cache hits and eviction semantics
growth_areas: Ready to incorporate asynchronous background job workers and message queues in Module 07 to offload click event analytics and handle reliable retry pipelines
data.recommendation: Advance to Module 07 (Background Jobs & Analytics) to decouple click tracking analytics and build resilient asynchronous event processing.
